1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora, de tamaño variado, con tallo fino, hojas alternas, simples y oblongas, inflorescencia axilar y fruto en baya globosa con una semilla única. Smilacaceae Smilax domingensis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant of variable size, with slender stem, alternate, simple and oblong leaves, axillary inflorescence, and globose berry fruit containing a single seed. Family Smilacaceae, Smilax domingensis.
